blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Residents of Laoag City in Ilocos Norte were urged to take precautions against heat-related illnesses after the city recorded a heat index of 39 degrees Celsius on Monday, Nov. 16, with the same level expected on Tuesday, Nov. 17.
